'''Seiera''' is the name of a horse owned by [[Min Farshaw]].

==Appearance==
Seiera is a mouse-colored mare.

==Activities==
Seiera belonged to one of the [[Aes Sedai]] that participated in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. She was appropriated by [[Rand al'Thor]] and given to Min to ride back to [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|7|3}} Later, Seiera carries Min to a meeting with the [[Sea Folk]].{{ref/book|7|34}}
